description: Search what WarmInboxes publishes: operator notes (WarmInboxes' rules from running fleets, with the research behind them), cold email guides, deliverability playbooks, original studies and their datasets, costed infrastructure recipes, tool demo videos, inbox guides per sequencer and AI agent, provider comparisons, Claude skills, the changelog, the product pages (the ChatGPT plugin, the Claude connector, the MCP servers, the platform features, each with its current status), and the offer and about pages. Searches titles and full text, and each match carries the passage that best answers the query. It holds WarmInboxes' own studies as well as guides: 5 published studies, each with a stable WI-RESEARCH ID; type "study" lists every one, and https://warminboxes.com/research.json is the index. read_resource returns a whole page.

limit.description: How many matches, 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

query.description: A question or topic, e.g. "warming up Azure inboxes" or "Smartlead".

type.description: Optional: only this kind of resource.

name: find_resources
title: Guides, playbooks, studies and videos
